protocol: Start from the recorded residual IDs of SYNC_BRAIN_GLYPH.json observed arm. Thirteen old readouts are recomputed with the same frozen-score recipe, then extra readouts are added wave by wave. All fits use repeats 1..r-1 only; full-gallery scores are frozen before label alignment; each cycle removes the union of correctly recognised residual classes across the eight mouse-days, then re-peels on the remaining candidates. No fusion weights, no per-readout tuning, no re-scoring after masking.
caveat: Truth-assisted oracle diagnostic. The reported coverage is the union over eight mouse-days with known labels and sequential candidate removal; it is not a deployable single-shot accuracy.
readout_protocol: ridge_dct32 / ridge_pix16 / ridge_stroke: 50 ms log1p counts -> ridge (alpha=.1*mean(diag(X.T@X))) to centred DCT32, 16x16 pooled brightness, or a fixed 4x4-cell 8-orientation gradient histogram; cosine full gallery. corr25 / corr10: per-session training mean/std, cross-day per-character template, Pearson correlation. lda50: pooled diagonal variance with 0.2 shrinkage. softmax25: light linear softmax (12 epochs, AdamW, weight decay 1e-2). ridge_tsum50: per-bin/unit standardisation then mean+variance+maximum over five 50 ms bins -> ridge to DCT32. Wave2: binned spike-presence templates, per-time-block event statistics with diagonal Gaussian, PCA-whitened nearest centroid (128 dimensions). Wave3: 50 ms correlation, 25 ms spike-presence, 25 ms PCA centroid, 25 ms LDA with 0.05 shrinkage.
